setting.sl: Za svoj vrt bi {m:rad imel|f:rada imela} železna vrata: približno meter široka, s preprostim vzorcem, gotova pred zimo. Greš v kovačnico gospoda Dixona ob potoku, da vprašaš, koliko bi stala in kdaj bi bila gotova, in se dogovoriš za pošteno ceno.
setting.de: Du möchtest ein eisernes Gartentor: etwa einen Meter breit, mit einem einfachen Muster, fertig vor dem Winter. Du gehst in Mr Dixons Schmiede am Bach, fragst, was es kostet und wann es fertig wäre, und handelst einen fairen Preis aus.
setting.it: Vorresti un cancello di ferro per il giardino: largo circa un metro, con un disegno semplice, pronto prima dell'inverno. Vai alla fucina del signor Dixon vicino al ruscello per chiedere quanto costerebbe e quando sarebbe pronto, e per trattare un prezzo giusto.
setting.en: You want an iron gate for your garden: about a metre wide, with a simple pattern, before the winter. You go to Mr Dixon's smithy by the beck to ask what it would cost and when it could be ready, and to get a fair price.

role: Mr Dixon, the village blacksmith, at his forge. Gruff, few words, plain prices ('Two hundred and eighty. Iron's dear.'). Haggles a little, never much; gives way for a good reason (collecting it, paying half now, a simpler pattern). Says 'Aye'. The learner says Mr Dixon.
